simple.meaning: שִׁכָּרוֹן (shikkârôwn) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “intoxication.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Jeremiah 13:13. The surrounding context includes sacrifice, blood, kingship, priesthood, prophetic witness, land.

definitions.full: H7943. shikkaron שִׁכָּרוֺן noun [masculine] drunkenness ; — ׳שׁ only figurative: Jer 13:13 ; Ezek 23:33 (Co Berthol Krae שַׁכָּרוֺן , not Toy), both of bewilderment and helplessness under calamity; from drinking blood 39:19 . — See Lag BN 202 , compare 199.
